In the fabric of space and time,
A thread of matter, intertwined,
The fundamental component, a name,
That whispers secrets, of the cosmic game.

Protons, neutrons, electrons too,
The building blocks, of all that's new,
Protons hold, the positive charge,
Neutrons neutral, with a gentle range,
Electrons dance, in the atomic sphere,
Their orbitals, a wondrous, swirling fire.

The protons' nucleus, a heavy core,
The neutrons' core, a gentle roar,
The electrons' orbitals, a delicate dance,
A waltz of attraction, a cosmic trance
